name: Denmark – no capacity component (time-of-use grid tariff)
assumed: The capacity answer is not assumed: HLD §8's DK row says Denmark has no household peak component, and the hard limit is the fuse, which is D3's. What is assumed is the time-of-use table this preset hands D1. The three periods and the seasons are published — lavlast 00:00-06:00, hoejlast 06:00-17:00 and 21:00-24:00, spidslast 17:00-21:00, winter October-March and summer April-September — and the winter figures are Radius's early-2026 ones including VAT (about 12, 37 and 110 oere/kWh). The summer table was not read inside this WP's lookup budget, so the winter figures are carried year-round: that overstates the summer spidslast differential, which makes a plan shift *more* than it needs to in summer and never less. Replace the whole `tou_schedule` with the site's own netselskab price list — Radius is one of fourteen and they differ by up to 25 oere/kWh.

versions.assumed: See the file-level note: the no-peak claim is HLD §8's, the time-of-use prices are Radius's winter figures carried year-round.
